correctness.rationale: For H_n=K_{n,n} minus its perfect matching, a proper mixed vertex-color class can only be {a_i,b_i}. Remaining A/B pure partitions violate the bichromatic 4-vertex PATH condition if both contain non-singleton blocks except when each has exactly the same unique 2-index block; all other valid cases have at least one discrete side. Counting selected unpaired index subsets and using Σ_{r=b}^n C(n,r)S(r,b)=S(n+1,b+1) yields c_{n,n+j}=2S(n+1,j+1)-C(n,j)+C(n,2)C(n-2,j) for 0≤j≤n; labelled palette polynomial Σ c_{n,k}(q)_k; exactly 1+C(n,2) optimum unlabelled partitions at k=n. Independently constructed all proper vertex partitions at n=3,4 and enumerated P4 paths directly: profiles {3:4,4:14,5:9,6:1} and {4:7,5:38,6:50,7:16,8:1}; matches coefficients. n≥3 assumptions and noninduced P4 correctly considered; finite counts are corroboration only.
